about: The boss whose kill finishes each Forever dungeon, keyed by the instance map ID (8th return of GetInstanceInfo); the encounter IDs are the encounterID that ENCOUNTER_START/ENCOUNTER_END report. A run that kills one of these counts as completed even without a completion event (groups formed outside the dungeon finder never get one), and the addon ends the run 20 seconds after the kill. Classic dungeons: the last boss in each dungeon's encounter order in the Forever client's DungeonEncounter table (build 1.60.1.70862, wago.tools branch wowf); where wings share one map, each wing's last boss is listed. Forever's new dungeons are listed only once a live full clear has shown the last boss ('evidence'); the others wait in 'pending', which nothing reads for completion. Kept in sync with addon/ForeverTracker/Data/Dungeons.lua by a test.

pending.about: Forever dungeons whose final boss is not verified. Nothing reads this section for completion: their runs keep their boss kills, and once an entry moves to 'dungeons', `python -m app.cli recover-outcomes` previews which stored runs a confirmed final kill would complete. Map and encounter IDs below are from the client's Map and DungeonEncounter tables (builds 1.60.1.70862 and 1.60.1.71037) and match DBM-Party-Forever (DeadlyBossMods/DBM-Dungeons 648ae8c, SetZone/SetEncounterID). What is missing is which kill ends the dungeon.

2999.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
2999.sources: Warcraft Tavern guide: 'Rath'mael, the dungeon's final boss'; its walkthrough ends there.
2999.why_pending: No live trace. Two side encounters start from interactables (Viktor the Vile 3411, a fireplace; The Abandoned 3357, a statue), Lordaeron Captain (3408) is a rare, and one guide placed Viktor after Rath'mael. The guide also names a 'The Baron' that the client table does not have.
2999.evidence_needed: One full clear including Viktor and The Abandoned, recorded by addon 0.2.12 or later: ENCOUNTER_END with success 1 for 3354 on map 2999 and no encounter started after it in that instance.

3039.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
3039.sources: Warcraft Tavern guide: 'the final boss Overlord Mugg in a house at the very end of the long winding road'.
3039.why_pending: No live trace. The guide's names disagree with the client table ('Overlord Mugg' vs 'Overseer Mugg'; a 'Bossman Toof' with no client encounter), and it describes 'some alternate paths'.
3039.evidence_needed: One full clear: the encounter ID and name the client reports at the last kill on map 3039, and whether 'Bossman Toof' starts an encounter at all.

2994.name: Alcaz Prison
2994.sources: Warcraft Tavern guide: 'Zarla Ober is technically the final boss' (she becomes Blazeroar), but The Questioner, behind a locked door near the entrance, is fought 'on your way out', 'making him the real final boss'.
2994.why_pending: Two candidates. Listing Blazeroar would end the run 20 seconds after it, and a Questioner kill on the way out would then not be recorded.
2994.evidence_needed: One full clear including The Questioner: which of 3409 and 3415 is killed last on map 2994, and whether Zarla Ober's change into Blazeroar reports one encounter (3409) or two.

2974.name: Blackmaw Hold
2974.client_last_by_order: 3336 Unbound Spirit (OrderIndex 6000 of 7; the only encounter with table flag 128)
2974.sources: Warcraft Tavern: 'Varrox Bleakhoof, the dungeon's final boss'; Wowhead and Method also call him the last boss. Tavern: Unbound Spirit is in a side area, the dungeon has 'no set path', and a ledge drop leads straight to Varrox, after which you 'grab the remaining bosses on your way out'.
2974.why_pending: The client table's order and the guides disagree (the order rule would pick the side-area Unbound Spirit), and the ledge route means bosses can be killed after Varrox, which ending the run at Varrox would drop.
2974.evidence_needed: Two full clears on map 2974, one along the main path and one using the ledge drop: whether any encounter is started after 3334 in the same instance.

3001.name: The Shaper's Terrace
3001.sources: Warcraft Tavern: activating all four Archival Devices 'will summon Nanaya, the dungeon's final boss. Defeating her completes the dungeon.'
3001.why_pending: No live trace, and the 11 client encounters include summoned and optional bosses (Vitrix can be skipped), so a full clear cannot be recognized by count.
3001.evidence_needed: One full clear on map 3001: ENCOUNTER_END with success 1 for 3502 as the last encounter in that instance.
